briefing.summary: Established on final approach, runway 35 in sight. Tower has just cleared you to land.

lastTransmission.speaker: atc
lastTransmission.text: Mike X-ray Golf, runway three five, cleared to land, wind three two zero at eight.

challenge.expectedText: Cleared to land runway three five, Mike X-ray Golf.

elements.label: Clearance
elements.hint: Use the words 'cleared to land' — not 'landing' or 'on final'.

challenge.explanation: MATS Part 4: landing clearance is a mandatory readback item. Include 'cleared to land' verbatim and the runway. Wind isn't part of the readback.
